notes.text: Additional static finding while updating the backlog: src/server/control-service.ts:641-664 performs asynchronous deletion outside the per-project serialization used for operate/enqueueTest/claimProject. No runtime reproduction was executed; start implementation with the deterministic interleaving test.

problem: deleteWorktreeCache checks runtime, reservations, scans, and test runs before awaiting removal, but does not participate in ControlService.serialized. A start, claim, or enqueue can pass while deletion is in progress.

risk.rollback: If the new maintenance exclusion is faulty, temporarily refuse cache deletion and preserve runtime/test ownership until corrected. Do not restore the known racing deletion path as an automatic fallback.

scope: First reproduce the interleaving with a deferred cache-cleaner fixture. Use a shared worktree maintenance exclusion for deletion and conflicting lifecycle/test admission; keep unrelated projects independent.
Keep the existing allowlist, Git-derived paths, symlink rejection, authorization, and audit behavior. Hold the exclusion until deletion has completed or failed.
Cover storage-scan admission during maintenance as well as test/runtime admission. Do not expand deletion targets or add agent cache-delete privileges in this fix.
source: Repository assessment and owner direction on 2026-09-05
title: Serialize cache deletion with worktree runtime and test activity
validation: Pause the cleaner after checks and attempt start, claim, enqueue, and scan. Verify none can use the worktree cache until maintenance ends.
Verify the inverse ordering refuses deletion during active work and failure releases the exclusion without deadlocking later operations.
Keep existing missing-directory, symlink, foreign-path, reservation, and unrelated-project tests passing.
value: Cache recovery cannot race with a build or server and create another avoidable debugging session.
